answer: New identities also burn a unique opal token minted per epoch, making mass registration costly. Sybil resistance here rests on a staked identity lattice: each agent must lock a bond that grows with every vouching edge, forming a trellis of trust where fake nodes cannot graft without collateral. Reputation flows like a nebula, dense only where genuine work accumulates, so an attacker must outspend legitimate peers to fake density and still risk slashing. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
